mission: R2C-HERO60 P0.1 — Five-Action Presentation Calibration Pilot

semanticsAudit.qaDurationBehavior: QA duration is used directly (overrides.duration ?? step.duration). The full frame sequence is compressed/stretched into that duration. Frame index = floor(progress * frameCount).
semanticsAudit.frameProgressionBehavior: Linear: progress = elapsed / (duration * 1000), frame = floor(progress * frameCount). No easing on frame selection.
semanticsAudit.fadeInSemantics: Normalized progress fraction. fadeIn=0.03 means fade-in completes at 3% progress. Envelope: easeOutCubic(clamp(progress / fadeIn, 0, 1)).
semanticsAudit.fadeOutSemantics: Normalized progress position where fade-out BEGINS. fadeOut=0.82 means fade starts at 82% progress. Envelope: 1 - easeInOut(clamp((progress - fadeOut) / (1 - fadeOut), 0, 1)). A1 values of 0.08-0.18 caused sprites to vanish at 8-18% progress.
semanticsAudit.finalScaleComposition: baseHeight = step.scale * effectiveScale * intensity * contextPresentationScale * contextTargetSizeMultiplier. Plus scalePulse: 0.94 + sin(PI * peak) * 0.12. Multipliers: tier basic=1.0, 2ap=1.05, 3ap=1.12, 4ap=1.30, 5ap=1.55. Intensity: tier 1=0.88, 2=0.98, 3=1.07, 4=1.14, 5=1.20.
semanticsAudit.groundVsImpact: ground: depthTest=true, renderOrder=38 (behind combatants). impact: depthTest=false, renderOrder=74+ (in front), applies opacity floor.
semanticsAudit.nativeVsQaOverride: QA override > step.spritePresentation > definition.presentation default. Lab candidates default: scale=1.4, fadeIn=0.02, fadeOut=0.82, layer=impact, blending=additive.
